digest.component_or_area: LLM runner telemetry / CI weekly jobs
propositions: Token usage (input/output/cache tokens + request count) from real LLM calls in weekly jobs (external-integration.yml and prompt-eval.yml) is currently not recorded or retrievable
Usage is computed and logged at PydanticAIRunner.run but lost downstream: eval path drops _usage, pytest surfaces nothing, and INFO logs are suppressed by NullHandler

A new usage_log module with record() and summarize() functions should provide an opt-in JSONL sink (via REBAR_USAGE_LOG env var) at the shared _usage seam in runner.py to capture both job paths with a single hook
Both weekly workflows must set REBAR_USAGE_LOG, append summarize() output to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY with if:always(), and upload the raw JSONL artifact for durable, machine-readable retention
